spark_open.description: The creature is shown in right-facing profile standing on pale ground. It has the head, fur and paws of a wolf on a quadrupedal body that is almost entirely covered in dark gray to black glossy overlapping segmented armor. A very long, thick, plate-covered neck arches up and forward from the shoulders, loops back on itself over the back, and connects to the wolf-like head at the right end. The dorsal and lateral surfaces, the outer sides of the legs, the tail and a small patch on the forehead are covered in large overlapping plates, while the ventral chest, belly and inner legs show paler segmented skin with a row of small oval openings along the flank. The overall impression is a single continuous wolf-like quadruped encased in woodlouse/isopod-like armor with two thin antennae on the forehead.

spark_open.description: The creature is depicted in right-facing profile standing on a pale, lightly shaded ground. It has the head, ears and muzzle of a wolf at the front of a long, arched neck, joined to a low, elongated quadrupedal body that is almost entirely covered in overlapping dark gray armored plates. The body is supported by four jointed legs ending in clawed paws, with a long tapering segmented tail extending from the rear and curving downward. The dorsal and lateral surfaces from the base of the skull along the neck, back, sides, tail and upper portions of the legs are covered in glossy, overlapping plates with pointed rear edges, while the underside of the chest, belly and lower legs show paler, wrinkled skin and fur. A row of small oval openings is visible along the mid-flank. The overall impression is a single wolf-headed, heavily armored quadruped.

meta_spark.description: A large quadruped shown in right-facing profile standing on four sturdy legs with wolf-like paws. The trunk is bulky with a pale segmented underbelly and a back, sides, legs and tail covered in dark gray overlapping rounded armor plates.
